verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official MCP server enabling assistants like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf to control a browser, and a live probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is real and gated behind managed auth, not just a docs claim. This is a server-side product (browser automation platform), so exposing an MCP server for other agents is squarely in-category, not na. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on reports specifically using the MCP server (community citations only cover other features, not MCP usage).
